historical_record.problem: Yoga, Pilates, fitness and other movement teachers often build substantial paid video libraries in one language, while reaching international students requires re-recording, accurate movement-specific translation, repackaging and marketing in another language.
historical_record.reason: The underlying expansion need and economics are credible and the idea is cheap to test, but basic dubbing is commoditized and direct willingness to pay for a movement-specific international-expansion service is not yet proven.
historical_record.solution_wedge: Not AI dubbing itself. Managed international expansion: teacher-voice localization plus movement/anatomy cue QA, localized packaging, platform launch and optionally distribution/revenue share.
historical_record.target_user: Established non-English movement creators and small schools with proven paid video libraries and existing audience/revenue
historical_record.title: International expansion studio for movement creators
